capabilities.name: MO-021 Deterministic Pipeline Evaluation Baseline
capabilities.responsibility: Score immutable captures of the current canonical guarded Intelligence execution and released response with transparent deterministic assertions, while retaining the historical injected runner only for legacy baseline compatibility.
capabilities.authority_role: Evaluation authority only. The active canonical path consumes already-produced orchestration StageResult objects and released response artifacts; it does not execute, replay, reinterpret, or bypass insurance-intelligence stages.
safety_invariants: The assertion engine scores captured runs without modifying or re-executing the pipeline.
Canonical final evaluation must consume the governed execution prefix already produced by the orchestration runtime rather than reconstructing a private stage order.
The historical PipelineRunner remains compatibility infrastructure and is not authoritative evidence of current guarded end-to-end execution.
A non-PASS evaluation result fails the FINAL_EVALUATION stage closed rather than releasing an unevaluated response.
capabilities.notes: Repaired under Issue #263. Current FINAL_EVALUATION adapts canonical StageResult and released-response artifacts into the existing immutable evaluation capture model. The legacy hard-coded PIPELINE_STAGE_ORDER is retained for historical tests only and is not used by the active canonical final-evaluation path.
